implementation_stages.description: Changes required by the plan review (docs/Comparison Plan.md): session clusters for the evaluation set, folds stratified by class presence, row weights, conflict report, displaced control contexts, common signal contract (1 to 30 Hz, MAD scaling per recording, clip 50 since 2026-11-24), manifest schema 2, and comparison adapters of the retained models (external scaling, edge mask, inside-segment initial patches, placement readout). The retained model files are unchanged. The hashes below supersede earlier hashes of the same paths. scripts/make_tuev_identities.py writes the identity CSV from the folder layout as a separate, explicit step. After the first HPC build found 20 groups of EDF files with identical bytes in the training set, data/duplicates.py merges each group into one recording with the annotation rows of all copies and joins the clusters of the group ([splits] duplicate_content). scripts/audit_manifest.py is the read-only audit of a built manifest behind the audit tables of the plan. After the audit of the first manifest, the conflict rule background_yields was added and set in the configuration files (user decision of 2026-11-24); example IDs no longer depend on the edge or conflict rule. The dataset has a keep view (Partition.conflict_view) for the published row-level protocol. scripts/audit_signals.py is the signal audit of the training patients, with thresholds fixed before its first run. The reader compares the build runtime in two scopes (runtime scope: tables and signal), so reader-only edits do not invalidate a manifest or the recording cache.

implementation_stages.status: Protocol confirmed by the user on 2026-11-24, with every test and run on the HPC. Gates 1 to 6 passed on the HPC (206 tests at commit a19f1c4; parity with the author code at its commit b7716e1). The base and background levels ran at signal level 8 with a budget of 3,000 steps and were read on 2026-11-25: P5 holds, P7 does not hold (two of the four templates match a background dictionary at about 0.75). The budget rule proved too weak (the gradient cells have 85% to 100% of their loss decrease at 3,000 steps); a changed rule and the reading of the recovery are open decisions of the user (protocol, section 13). Step 3 (levels with artifacts, bursts and event pairs; P1 to P4 and P6) is not built. Decision of the user on 2026-11-25: the budget of the gradient cells is 12,000 steps; the rule in the code is the share of the loss decrease (at least 95% of the decrease at the largest checkpoint), and the base and background levels run again in a new root. The changed rule, its tests (207 in all) and the report by template have not run. Step 3 is built on 2026-11-25 and has not run: the levels amplitude_artifacts, burst_near_event (layout confirmed by the user that day) and overlap, and the reader of P1, P1s, P2, P3, P4 and P6 (213 tests in all). Rerun of base and background at 12,000 steps (commit acef908, read 2026-11-25 from the printed report): the four gates pass, P5 holds, P7 does not hold, and the learned recovery and recall of the gradient cells change by at most 0.01 against 3,000 steps. The levels of step 3 have not run. The burst level refused to run at its first validity check (raw side 0.39 to 0.69 against the 0.80 needed; cosine side 0.96 to 1.00). Its calibration changed on 2026-11-25: the burst factor is measured inside the pooling window of the event, and each template takes the first of the ratios 1.5, 2.0, 2.5 and 3.0 that passes the check (214 tests; not yet run). All 14 levels ran on the HPC (root synthetic-002, 1,815 records, 7.6 hours of fits) and were read on 2026-11-26: P3, P4 and P5 hold; P1 is opposite; P1s, P2 and P6 are undecided; P7 does not hold (protocol, section 15). The user accepted stage 2 as complete on 2026-11-26.

implementation_stages.status: The open points of the signal contract are settled. The scale audit ran on the HPC at commit 6a09ac3 (339 training recordings; its 6 tests passed) and was read on 2026-11-26: outcome per_channel_with_profile_level by its fixed rules. Decision of the user on 2026-11-26: an exposure plan with a quota per patient in place of a sampler (5 minutes per patient for whole recordings, 20 events per patient and class for annotated contexts). The user confirmed the protocol of the slice on 2026-11-26. Step 1 of 3 (exposure plans, profile input level, reader of plan units) ran on the HPC on 2026-11-27 at commit ed6fc96: gate 1 passes (236 tests), gate 4 passes (the stored plan of artifacts/tuev-exposure-001 equals a new build), the plan part of gate 2 passes, and the 12 count lines equal the expected counts of protocol section 16.1. One sentence of the confirmed protocol is amended by the build: the profile input is computed from the primary input, with no second read of the recording. Step 2 of 3 (readouts, token counts, spectral control, bag of spectra, two heads, evaluator, the run of the frozen arms and the controls, the report reader, 25 tests) was built on 2026-11-27 (commit 4b19634). Its smoke run on the HPC that day (small settings) read the 339 training recordings: gates 2, 3 and 5 pass and gate 6 (determinism) fails, probably through k-means with several threads; the logistic fits were slow. Changes after the smoke run (commit 36f1fd3): k-means and the logistic fit run with one thread, gate 6 stores its counts by arm, 27 tests in all for step 2 (protocol section 16.2). The second smoke run at that commit passes gates 2, 3, 5 and 6 (fold 0 repeats bit by bit in all arms) in 157 s against 1,804 s. The suite passes at commit 36f1fd3 (263 tests). The full run of step 2 at that commit (root artifacts/slice-step2-001, 45.3 minutes, read on 2026-11-27) passes gates 2, 3, 5 and 6. Balanced accuracy on the full readout with the logistic head: prior 0.167, spectral 0.441, spectra_bag 0.396, S1-frozen-data 0.434, S1-frozen-gauss 0.424, SF-frozen-data 0.453; the displaced control reads 0.32 to 0.34. Results and post hoc observations are in protocol section 17. Step 3 of 3 (the learned arms S1-L1 and S1-L2, the levels of atoms, tiling, token score, input and exposure, the cross-fitting check, a run that is stored fold by fold, and the reader of M1, M4 to M11 and S1 to S7) is built on 2026-11-27 and has not run; its rules are fixed in protocol section 16.3 before any learned arm has run on the corpus; 7 tests.
implementation_stages.description: scripts/audit_scales.py measures, on the training recordings, whether one robust scale per channel and recording differs from one recording scale times a fixed channel profile, and whether events enter the scale. Its three rules and three outcomes are fixed in the script before any run. The user asked for the audit on 2026-11-26. src/eeg_compare/slice/ holds the code of the slice outside eeg_compare.data, so that it does not change the runtime fingerprint of the manifest. The expected counts of the plans come from a separate count of the manifest tables (protocol, section 16.1).
